data.exact_reserve_text: Profit / (loss) attributable to underwriting years of account: 2021: 27,065; 2020 & prior (including 2018 & prior legacy transaction): (324).

prior_year_events.impact_description: A legacy transaction was completed with Enstar syndicate 2008 for the 2018 & prior years of account. This provided a significant capital benefit, transferred claims handling obligations to Enstar, freed up resources, and mitigated the impact of current inflation on prior year reserves.

named_events.loss_description: The account was unaffected by hurricanes Fiona
The account was unaffected by hurricanes Ian

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1492 reported a net release of GBP 26.741 million in prior year reserves for 2022. This was primarily driven by a profit of GBP 27.065 million attributable to the 2021 year of account. The 2020 and prior years of account showed a loss of GBP 0.324 million, which included the impact of a legacy transaction with Enstar syndicate 2008 for the 2018 & prior years. This transaction transferred claims handling obligations and helped mitigate the impact of inflation on prior year reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is a net profit/loss attributable to underwriting years, as a gross figure was not explicitly stated and the gross claims development triangle was deemed unreliable due to a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) for 2018 & prior years of account.
